player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Cɔ̈k yïn wëu ee **[macro  micro]** (akɔ̈ɔ̈k de rou 0-8):
• *macro*  = yïn kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee mini-board yïn tɛ̈ɛ̈m ee
• *micro* = yïn kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee mini-board ee
Mɛ̈t yïn ee `[7 8]` ➜ yïn kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee mini-board 7, kɔ̈ɔ̈k 8, ku
yïn kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈k ee mini-board 8 ee.

Yïn ee `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lɔ̈k adhil ya tɔ̈ në kë de [macro micro] ku nimirai 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kë cï gɔ̈ɔ̈r adhil rot looi në kaam de 0 ku 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row, wala col aye tɔ̈u aɣeer.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Ɣön cï mac acï jal thiäŋ.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Raan ye gam adhil bï ya luui në thöny dɛ̈t peei yic.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Aacï wëu ke kɔc cï gam ya gäm.

next_board.any: kuat kä ye kek looi në micro board yic

game_action.played: Tiŋ {player_id} ee cäthië në thïn micro {macro_idx}, kɛm {micro_idx} (thïn {row}, kɛm {col}). Tiŋ {opponent_id} acë kekë në {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} ee yen cï Ultimate Tic Tac Toe! bɛ̈n tiaam.
outcome.draw: Aköl ë yic ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ!
